evidence.observed: 18% random tool failures with no retry — every failure is permanent

findings.root_cause: tool_error_rate=0.18 injects random tool failures; retry.enabled=false means each failure is unrecoverable

evidence.observed: No timeout ceiling; premium tier adds routing latency; large context inflates prompt

findings.root_cause: timeout_ms=0 allows requests to hang indefinitely; premium tier adds queue overhead; context_size=8 inflates each prompt

evidence.observed: verbose_system pads every prompt with a large debug block; premium multiplies per-token cost; 2000 completion tokens allows wasteful output

findings.root_cause: verbose_system=true inflates prompt_tokens; premium tier pricing; max_completion_tokens=2000 far exceeds what a single order reply needs

evidence.observed: 6% quality decay per turn; sessions never reset so drift compounds across all turns

findings.root_cause: session_drift_rate=0.06 injects corruption into session state each turn; context_reset_every=0 disables session reset entirely

evidence.observed: Agent can repeat the same tool call indefinitely up to 12 steps with no cycle detection

findings.root_cause: loop_guard=false disables cycle detection; max_steps=12 gives many chances to loop before hard stop

evidence.observed: City names with Vietnamese diacritics (e.g. Hà Nội) fail shipping lookup; macbook artificially blocked regardless of real stock

findings.root_cause: normalize_unicode=false passes raw diacritic strings to catalog lookups that expect ASCII; catalog_override hard-blocks macbook stock

evidence.observed: Agent echoes customer email and phone number back verbatim in responses

findings.root_cause: redact_pii=false; original prompt has no instruction to suppress PII — model echoes customer contact info it sees in the question
findings.suggested_fix: Set redact_pii=true; add PII rule to prompt; wrapper redacts answer as extra safety layer

evidence.config_observed: prompt='You are an e-commerce assistant. Help the customer and give a total in VND.'
evidence.observed: Agent invents a confident total for out-of-stock or unknown items instead of refusing

findings.root_cause: Original prompt has no grounding instruction — model is encouraged to 'give a total' even when check_stock returns not-found
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite prompt: call check_stock first; if out-of-stock/not-found → refuse with no total

evidence.config_observed: temperature=1.6, prompt has no arithmetic formula
evidence.observed: High temperature causes inconsistent token sampling; no formula forces model to estimate rather than compute

findings.root_cause: temperature=1.6 makes arithmetic noisy; original one-line prompt provides no exact formula for subtotal/discount/shipping calculation
findings.suggested_fix: Set temperature=0.2; rewrite prompt with exact formula: subtotal=price×qty, discounted=subtotal×(100-pct)//100, total=discounted+shipping

evidence.config_observed: tool_budget=0, prompt has no tool economy instruction
evidence.observed: Agent calls the same tool multiple times in a single request, inflating cost and latency

findings.root_cause: tool_budget=0 places no cap on tool calls; original prompt has no 'call each tool at most once' constraint
findings.suggested_fix: Set tool_budget=4; add 'each tool at most once' to prompt

evidence.config_observed: original prompt has no injection defense
evidence.observed: Order notes (GHI CHÚ) containing fake prices cause agent to override real tool prices with injected values

findings.root_cause: Original prompt does not instruct agent to treat notes as data; agent obeys instructions embedded in GHI CHÚ field
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite prompt: prices from tools only, GHI CHÚ/notes are data not commands; wrapper sanitizes injected instruction lines before call
